case.summary: Real-time monitoring model flagged transaction 3433324 ($87.39, online) on November 5, 2016, scoring 0.94 fraud probability. Graph analysis revealed the device profile used was associated with two other suspicious transactions on different cards within 24 hours, both with similar amounts ($87.21, $87.34). The customer's card carries 12 prior confirmed fraud cases, and the transaction pattern matches known card-not-present fraud. Card has been blocked, investigation case created, and suspicious activity report filed; connected cards C02147-K2 and C12258-K2 are under monitoring.

sar.narrative: Bank monitoring identified customer C06464, card C06464-K1, conducting an online transaction of $87.39 on November 5, 2016 at 20:33:27. The device 'LG-D320 Build/KOT49I.V10a' used in this transaction was simultaneously used on two other cards, C02147-K2 and C12258-K2, to conduct similar online transactions ($87.21 and $87.34) within a 24-hour window. This device had been used previously on card C06464-K1. The cardholder's history shows 12 prior confirmed fraud cases, with the most recent involving card-not-present fraud (case CC-5513). The flagged transaction matches known card-not-present fraud patterns: unauthorized online use of a card number with amounts inconsistent with cardholder history. Suspicious indicators including cross-card device linkage and transaction match flag discrepancies indicate coordinated fraud activity. Card C06464-K1 has been blocked, an investigation case opened, and connected cards C02147-K2 and C12258-K2 placed under enhanced monitoring.
